description: Follower and engagement history for an Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Bluesky account Exepal has seen: dated snapshots, change over the period, weekly growth and 30-day growth. Use to see how an account has grown over time: followers, posts and engagement rate per snapshot. History starts with the first lookup (one snapshot a day at most); Instagram creators in the South Asia index are snapshotted weekly. Returns points, from, to, change {followers, followersPct, perWeek, engagementRate, days}, growth30d and history[]. An account with no snapshots yet fails and is not charged: look it up once with social_instagram, social_tiktok, social_youtube or social_bluesky to start its history. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.
